question: Why is the Kula-born woman not recognized in her true Kula nature beyond caste?
premises: The Kula-born woman is the subject
She is described as having a nature beyond the multitude of castes
inference: The verse questions why the Kula-born woman, whose nature transcends caste classifications, is not properly known.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of kiṃ na is rhetorical
plain_english: How is the Kula-born woman not known, she whose nature is of Kula beyond the multitude of castes?
